facts.text: Get Warwick the smith's magical mithril chain shirt.
Dunk says Warwick's mithril chain shirt could help against the Brandonsford dragon once he has it.
facts.classification: {"opening_basis":"Trigger: achieving the want to get the shirt; benefit: magical armor protection when facing the dragon, as Dunk told the party.","opening_type":"enabling","form":"opening","helps_thread":"thread_2","role":"direct","support_basis":"Magical mithril armor could offer some protection against a dragon whose bite and sulfur have killed many, though how much it would help is unestablished.","goal_support":"low","action_basis":"The shirt is established in Warwick's shop and Dunk stated it could help against the dragon; armor protecting a wearer is a straightforward capability-to-need match.","action_supported":"yes","acquired_by_acting_on_opening":false}

facts.text: Warwick sleeps in a second-story bedroom whose window is left cracked open, giving a way into his shop-home where the mithril shirt is kept.
facts.classification: {"opening_basis":"Trigger: entering through the cracked-open second-story window; benefit: access into the closed shop-home holding the shirt without unlocking the door.","opening_type":"enabling","form":"opening","helps_thread":"thread_9","role":"direct","support_basis":"It gives physical entry to the house while the shop is closed, though the window opens into the room where Warwick sleeps.","goal_support":"medium","action_basis":"Dunk observed the open window; it is a supported physical opening, and Ingrid already climbs to it nightly.","action_supported":"yes","acquired_by_acting_on_opening":false}

facts.text: Ingrid's sleeping potion for Warwick, being made under Dunk's deal with her, could keep Warwick asleep while Dunk is inside his house.
facts.classification: {"opening_basis":"Trigger: carrying out the sleeping-potion plan with Ingrid; benefit: Warwick stays asleep so Dunk can be in the house without waking him.","opening_type":"enabling","form":"opening","helps_thread":"thread_9","role":"direct","support_basis":"A drugged Warwick removes the risk of the owner waking while Dunk reaches the shirt; the potion is not yet finished.","goal_support":"medium","action_basis":"Ingrid agreed to make the potion and is working on it; Dunk's plan to get the shirt rests on getting inside while Warwick sleeps.","action_supported":"yes","acquired_by_acting_on_opening":false}

facts.text: What magic does Warwick's mithril chain shirt have?
